summary.text: Pedro Soares de Souza, an independent whose campaign website describes work in restaurants, a small business he built and a move into a data career after COVID, lost the November 3, 2026 election for the U.S. House in Rhode Island's 1st District to Gabe Amo.
He lost to Gabe Amo, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
His campaign website presented his name as Pedro DeSouza and listed affordability, housing, single-payer health care and ending foreign wars among his positions.
